socrat-grafana.description: Read-only dashboards, Prometheus/Thanos, Alertmanager, Loki logs, Tempo traces and Pyroscope profiles. Never mute alerts to obtain green.

argocd.description: Official Argo CD Labs MCP, read-only application status, events, resources and diagnostics. Change deployments through Git, not MCP writes.

socrat-metrics.description: Official Prometheus project MCP, read-only Thanos-compatible queries and metric discovery through the existing Grafana Viewer datasource proxy. Not the direct Prometheus TSDB/admin API.

n8n.description: Official built-in n8n instance MCP. Pending owner enablement; read-only workflow search/details by default. No workflow execution or credential changes.

umami.description: Official Umami read-only analytics MCP; pending a scoped authorized API key, not the database password.

github.description: Official external GitHub MCP; remains disabled to preserve the previous project policy. Not a newly deployed Homelab service.
